IC1: intolerance of [OR] or allergy to ticagrelor [OR] or prasugrel
IC2: history of any stroke [OR], transient ischemic attack [OR] or intracranial bleeding
IC3: known intracranial neoplasm, intracranial arteriovenous malformation or intracranial aneurysm
IC4: active bleeding [OR], clinical findings, that in the judgement of the investigator are associated with an increased risk of bleeding
IC5: fibrin-specific fibrinolytic therapy  less than 24 h before randomization [OR], non-fibrin-specific fibrinolytic therapy less than 48 h before randomization
IC6: known platelet count < 100.000/µL at the time of screening
IC7: known anemia (hemoglobin <10 g/dL) at the time of screening
IC8: oral anticoagulation that cannot be safely discontinued for the duration of the study
IC9: INR known to be greater than 1.5 at the time of screening
IC11: moderate [OR] or severe hepatic dysfunction (Child Pugh B or C)
IC12: increased risk of bradycardia events (Sick Sinus [OR], AV block  grade II [OR] or III, bradycardia-induced syncope)
IC13: index event is an acute complication (< 30 days) of PCI
IC14: concomitant medical illness that in the opinion of the investigator is associated with a life expectancy < 1 year
IC15: concomitant oral [OR] or i.v. therapy [AND] with strong CYP3A Inhibitors (e.g. ketoconazole [OR], itraconazole [OR], voriconazole [OR], telithromycin [OR], clarithromycin [OR], nefazodone [OR], ritonavir [OR], saquinavir [OR], nelfinavir [OR], indinavir [OR], atazanavir [OR], grapefruit juice > 1 L/d), CYP3A substrates with narrow therapeutic indices (e.g. cyclosporine [OR], quinidine), or strong CYP3A inducers (e.g. rifampin [OR]/rifampicin [OR], phenytoin [OR], carbamazepine [OR], dexamethason [OR], phenobarbital ) that cannot be safely discontinued
IC16: =1 doses of ticagrelor [OR] or prasugrel within 5 days before randomisation
IC18: participation in another investigational drug study
IC20: for women of childbearing potential no negative pregnancy test and no agree to use reliable method of birth control during the study
IC21: Pregnancy, giving birth within the last 90 days, or lactation
IC22: inability to cooperate with protocol requirements
